Reading the PerimeterX challenge

PerimeterX (HUMAN) shows a Press & Hold button and the text "Please verify you are a human". It sets cookies like _px3 and loads captcha.px-cdn.net.
note: A blog that QUOTES the PerimeterX markers in prose but is NOT served by PerimeterX: no _px* cookie, no x-px header. The vendor gate must reject it. FP guard.
